title: Vampirism Entity Blood data map
description: NeoForge data map `vampirism:entity_blood` (de.teamlapen.vampirism.common.datamaps.EntityBloodEntry). File location: data/<namespace>/data_maps/entity_type/entity_blood.json. Sets how much blood a creature holds when bitten and whether it can be converted; 0 = not biteable.

replace.description: If true, clears all previously loaded entries before applying `values`.

values.description: Maps an entity type id (or a `#entity_type_tag`) to a blood entry.

remove.description: Entity type ids (or `#entity_type_tags`) to remove from the merged map.

idOrTag.description: A namespaced id, or a tag reference prefixed with `#`.

blood.description: Blood units the creature holds. 0 = not biteable / not convertible.
